body.name: GEUVADIS certification handle
body.construction: Reconstruct \(p^{\mathrm G}\) from the released counts, derive \(m^{\mathrm G}\) from the imposed \(s^{\mathrm G}\), impose the response-level shared-\(Z\) and relevance equations, run \(\mathscr A\), and apply the calibrated profile confidence-fiber procedure \(K_n\).
